title: Half-open intervals
spec: Implement overlaps(a, b), where a and b are non-empty half-open integer intervals [start, end) with start < end. Return True exactly when their intersection is non-empty. Touching endpoints do not overlap.
target_defect: Touching half-open endpoints are incorrectly treated as an intersection.
author_rationale: The change expresses overlap through the intersection bounds.
limitations: Small synthetic function; not a natural pull request. Correct means conforming to the stated contract and supplied checks, not universally bug-free.
